ticker: India cabinet clears EPF wage limit hike
New Zealand passes India trade deal

articles.headline: India Clears EPF Wage Upper Limit Hike
articles.whyItMatters: Expands social security coverage for millions of formal sector employees across India.
articles.brief: The Indian cabinet has cleared a plan to raise the Employees' Provident Fund wage upper limit to 25,000 rupees.

articles.headline: Government Defends New UPI Merchant Charges
articles.whyItMatters: Restructures the digital payment ecosystem by introducing fees for larger merchant transactions.
articles.brief: The Indian government has firmly defended the introduction of a Merchant Discount Rate for UPI transactions exceeding 2,000 rupees.

articles.headline: New Zealand Parliament Passes India Trade Deal
articles.whyItMatters: Reduces trade barriers and cuts tariffs on a wide range of bilateral export goods.
articles.brief: New Zealand parliament has officially passed a trade agreement with India, significantly cutting tariffs on most export items.

articles.headline: Death Penalty for Maoist Attack Convicts
articles.whyItMatters: Delivers a definitive judicial verdict on one of the deadliest political attacks in modern history.
articles.brief: A court has handed down the death penalty to all ten convicts involved in the 2013 Jhiram Valley Maoist attack.

articles.headline: India Protests Naval Collision to Pakistan
articles.whyItMatters: Escalates diplomatic tensions between neighboring nations following an incident at sea.
articles.brief: India has formally protested to Pakistan regarding the collision of naval ships operating in international waters.

articles.headline: Apple Considers Nvidia Tech for Servers
articles.whyItMatters: Signals a potential strategic shift in Apple's enterprise and cloud computing infrastructure partnerships.
articles.brief: Apple is reportedly considering Nvidia technology as it plans its long-awaited return to the server hardware market.

articles.headline: Gold Surges Ahead of Fed Rate Decision
articles.whyItMatters: Reflects broader macroeconomic hedging and shifting currency yields ahead of central bank updates.
articles.brief: Gold prices gained over one percent as oil prices and treasury yields slipped ahead of the Federal Reserve rate decision.

articles.headline: India Unveils Squad for West Indies Series
articles.whyItMatters: Reshapes national team leadership and player selections ahead of major upcoming cricket fixtures.
articles.brief: India announced its squads for the upcoming series, appointing Shubman Gill as ODI captain and resting several senior players.
